claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Anthropic posted a Forward Deployed Engineer role located in London, UK.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Anthropic says its Forward Deployed Engineers embed directly with its most strategic customers to drive AI adoption.
claims.quote: As a member of the Applied AI team at Anthropic, you will be a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) who embeds directly with our most strategic customers to drive transformational AI adoption.

claims.question: q2
claims.claim: Anthropic describes this hire as one of its founding Forward Deployed Engineers who will help shape its forward-deployed motion.
claims.quote: You will sit at the frontier of enterprise AI deployments and serve as one of our founding FDEs who helps to shape our forward-deployed motion.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The role’s responsibilities include working inside customer systems to build production applications with Claude models.
claims.quote: Work within customer systems to build production applications with Claude models, ensuring that these products meet customer requirements.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The role requires delivering technical artifacts such as MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills for customer production workflows.
claims.quote: Deliver technical artifacts for customers like MCP servers, sub-agents, and agent skills that will be used in production workflows.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The role includes identifying and codifying repeatable deployment patterns and feeding insights back to Product and Engineering teams.
claims.quote: Identify and codify repeatable deployment patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams.

claims.question: q5
claims.claim: The role requires frequent travel of 25-50% to customer sites to build in person with customers.
claims.quote: Travel frequently (25-50%) to customer sites to build in person with customers.

claims.question: q3
claims.claim: The annual salary range for the Forward Deployed Engineer role is £225,000 to £255,000 GBP.
